response.reason: The wrapper computes num_groups = K // group_size and clamps g_idx to num_groups - 1, so when K is not a multiple of group_size the trailing columns are assigned to the last full group instead of their own final (shorter) group, violating the stated contract that they use their own row in scales/zeros (ceil(K/group_size) rows).
